description: Deterministic ATS skill-gap scoring, must-have vs nice-to-have JD parsing, Google XYZ formula resume bullet diagnostics, and parser-safe ATS export.
author: zwhy149

tools.name: analyze_match
tools.description: Score a candidate resume against a target job description (0-100), returning weighted ATS sub-scores, matched/missing must-have and preferred skills, XYZ bullet audits, and priority actions.

parameters.name: resumeText
parameters.description: Full candidate resume in Markdown or plain text.

parameters.name: roleTitle
parameters.description: Optional override for target role title.

tools.name: parse_job_posting
tools.description: Extract structured role metadata, compensation hints, required years of experience, must-have skills, and bonus skills from a raw job description.

parameters.name: jdText
parameters.description: Raw job posting text or scraped markdown.

tools.name: audit_bullets
tools.description: Audit resume experience bullets against the Google XYZ formula (action verb, measurable metric, concise length, cliché check, and JD keyword alignment).

parameters.name: resumeOrBullets
parameters.description: Full resume text or newline-separated bullet list.

parameters.name: targetKeywords
parameters.description: Optional list of target JD skill strings to check alignment against.

tools.name: export_ats_resume
tools.description: Format a tailored resume into parser-safe plain text / Markdown, or compile a complete RoleFit ATS Match Scorecard Markdown report.
